---
title: "Project statistics"
description: "Commits, lines of code and co-authorship over time, with the milestones marked."
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
import yaml

from jaxdft.plotting import featured, style

style.enable()

ROOT = Path("../..")
CATEGORIES = {
    "package (src/)": "src/*.py",
    "tests": "tests/*.py",
    "documents (docs/)": "docs/*.qmd",
}
SEP = "\x1f"


def git(*args, ok=(0,)):
    done = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if done.returncode not in ok:
        raise RuntimeError(done.stderr)
    return done.stdout


def have_full_history():
    try:
        return git("rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository").strip() == "false"
    except (RuntimeError, FileNotFoundError):
        return False


def count(sha, pattern, pathspec):
    """Lines matching `pattern` in the files of `pathspec` at commit `sha`."""
    out = git("grep", "-c", "-E", pattern, sha, "--", pathspec, ok=(0, 1))
    return sum(int(line.rsplit(":", 1)[1]) for line in out.splitlines())


def co_author(trailer):
    """The co-author's name, without the e-mail address."""
    return trailer.split("<")[0].strip() if trailer.strip() else "none"


def utc(when):
    return pd.Timestamp(when).tz_convert("UTC").tz_localize(None)


def days_since(start, when):
    """Elapsed time from `start` to `when`, in days."""
    return (when - start) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)


def history():
    fmt = SEP.join([
        "%H",
        "%aI",
        "%(trailers:key=Co-Authored-By,valueonly,separator=;)",
    ])
    rows = []
    for line in git(
        "log", "--date-order", "--reverse", f"--format={fmt}"
    ).splitlines():
        sha, when, trailer = line.split(SEP)
        row = {
            "sha": sha[:7],
            "time": utc(when),
            "co-author": co_author(trailer),
        }
        for name, pathspec in CATEGORIES.items():
            row[name] = count(sha, "", pathspec)
        rows.append(row)
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df["commits"] = range(1, len(df) + 1)
    df["day"] = days_since(df["time"].iloc[0], df["time"])
    return df


FULL = have_full_history()
commits = history() if FULL else None
milestones = [
    {
        "label": m["id"],
        "day": days_since(commits["time"].iloc[0], utc(m["reached"])),
    }
    for m in yaml.safe_load(Path("../milestones.yml").read_text())
    if FULL and m["status"] == "done"
]


def with_milestones(chart):
    """`chart` with a labelled vertical rule at every completed milestone."""
    marks = pd.DataFrame(milestones)
    marks["offset"] = [
        14 * (i % 3) for i in range(len(marks))
    ]  # px, no overlap
    rule = (
        alt
        .Chart(marks)
        .mark_rule(color=style.TEXT_SECONDARY, strokeDash=[4, 3])
        .encode(x="day:Q")
    )
    text = (
        alt
        .Chart(marks)
        .mark_text(
            align="left", dx=4, baseline="top", color=style.TEXT_SECONDARY
        )
        .encode(x="day:Q", y=alt.Y("offset:Q", scale=None), text="label:N")
    )
    return (
        (chart + rule + text)
        .resolve_scale(y="independent")
        .properties(width=style.WIDTH, height=300)
    )


DAY = alt.X(
    "day:Q", title="Days since the first commit", axis=alt.Axis(tickMinStep=1)
)
```

This page shows the effort behind the project in numbers. Everything is
computed from the git history when the site is built. The dashed lines mark
when each milestone was reached. They come from `docs/milestones.yml`, the
same file that drives the [front page](../index.qmd).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if not FULL:
    print(
        "::: {.callout-warning}\n"
        "## History not available\n"
        "This site was built from a shallow clone or outside a git "
        "repository, so the statistics below could not be computed. Build "
        "from a full clone (`git fetch --unshallow`) to see them.\n"
        ":::"
    )
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
if FULL:
    last = commits.iloc[-1]
    co_authored = int((commits["co-author"] != "none").sum())
    # The interpretation below relies on these.
    assert len(commits) > 0 and last["package (src/)"] > 0
    featured.publish_numbers(
        "project_stats",
        {
            "strip": [
                {"value": len(commits), "label": "commits"},
                {
                    "value": f"{int(last['package (src/)']):,}",
                    "label": "lines in the package",
                },
                {
                    "value": f"{int(last['tests']):,}",
                    "label": "lines of tests",
                },
            ]
        },
    )
    summary = pd.DataFrame([
        {"quantity": "commits", "value": f"{len(commits)}"},
        {
            "quantity": "commits co-authored by an AI model",
            "value": f"{co_authored} ({co_authored / len(commits):.0%})",
        },
        *[
            {"quantity": f"lines, {name}", "value": f"{int(last[name]):,}"}
            for name in CATEGORIES
        ],
    ])
summary.style.hide(axis="index") if FULL else None
```

Lines are counted as they are in the files, including blank lines and
comments.

## Lines of code

Each milestone's acceptance tests are committed before its implementation, so
the test lines rise before the package lines do.

```{python}
#| column: page-inset
#| echo: false
if FULL:
    loc = commits.melt(
        id_vars=["day", "sha"],
        value_vars=list(CATEGORIES),
        var_name="category",
        value_name="lines",
    )
    loc_chart = with_milestones(
        alt
        .Chart(loc)
        .mark_line(interpolate="step-after")
        .encode(
            x=DAY,
            y=alt.Y("lines:Q", title="Lines"),
            color=alt.Color(
                "category:N",
                title=None,
                scale=alt.Scale(
                    domain=list(CATEGORIES), range=list(style.SERIES[:3])
                ),
            ),
            tooltip=["sha:N", "category:N", "lines:Q"],
        )
    )
loc_chart if FULL else None
```

## Commits and co-authorship

```{python}
#| column: page-inset
#| echo: false
if FULL:
    authors = sorted(commits["co-author"].unique())
    by_author = pd.concat([
        commits.assign(n=(commits["co-author"] == name).cumsum()).assign(**{
            "co-author": name
        })[["day", "sha", "co-author", "n"]]
        for name in authors
    ])
    assert len(authors) <= len(style.SERIES)
    commit_chart = with_milestones(
        alt
        .Chart(by_author)
        .mark_line(interpolate="step-after")
        .encode(
            x=DAY,
            y=alt.Y("n:Q", title="Cumulative commits"),
            color=alt.Color(
                "co-author:N",
                title="Co-author trailer",
                scale=alt.Scale(
                    domain=authors, range=list(style.SERIES[: len(authors)])
                ),
            ),
            tooltip=["sha:N", "co-author:N", "n:Q"],
        )
    )
commit_chart if FULL else None
```

A commit is counted for a co-author when its message carries a
`Co-Authored-By` trailer naming them. "none" means no trailer.
